role: Sheet opened from the Fitness tab route picker: 'My routes' lists SavedRouteStore routes with length/ascent/name filters; 'Find new' runs an OSM Overpass trail search near a one-shot location fix and, on pick, saves the trail to the library and hands a Route back. Also defines OpenStreetMapAttribution, SavedRouteRow, TrailRow and SearchLocationProbe (CLLocationManager wrapper).
types: DiscoverTrailsView: struct (View) — the route picker sheet
SavedRouteRow: private struct (View) — one saved-route card
TrailRow: private struct (View) — one search result card with map preview
SearchLocationProbe: private final class (@MainActor @Observable, CLLocationManagerDelegate) — one-shot location fix with retries
state: static lengthStepperMaxKm = 100 (max-length stepper top = no max), ascentSliderMaxMeters = 2000 (max-ascent slider edge = no max)
toplevel: Header (8-24) describes a two-phase UX whose results list shows 'name + length + ascent + difficulty + distance' and says picking saves to SavedRouteStore. @preconcurrency import CoreLocation. Presented only by WorkoutPreflightView.withRouteImporters as a sheet (WorkoutPreflightView.swift:569-572, onTrailPicked sets plan.selectedRoute) and hosted by RemainingScreenSnapshotTests.swift:66; FitnessTabView does not present it.
